dict.CASS și impozitul pe tichete se rețin în: Health contribution and income tax on the vouchers are withheld in the payroll, together with the salary (Sheets → Payroll).
dict.Tichetele date în plus se scad din cele: Vouchers given in excess are deducted from next month's, and those given short are added; take the leave days from Sheets → Leave tracker or from Monthly timesheet.
dict.Tichetele de masă pe o lună, pentru fiec: Meal vouchers for one month, for each employee: subtract leave and business trips from the working days and you get the days worked, the vouchers due and their value; with the vouchers given you see the difference to settle next month: OK (green), to give extra (yellow), given in excess (red).
dict.Tichetele se dau doar pentru zilele lucr: Vouchers are given only for days actually worked: not for annual leave, sick leave or business trip days on which the employee receives a daily allowance.
dict.Valoarea maximă a unui tichet o stabileș: The maximum value of a voucher is set by law and changes: check this year's value before entering it in the yellow cell.
dict.Lista cu tichetele de masă date pe o lun: The list of meal vouchers given for one month: each employee with the days worked, the number of vouchers, the value, the series or the card they were loaded on and the signature of receipt, with the total and the signatures of those who calculated and distributed them
